integrity.proof_type: analytic; finite numerical illustrations are supplementary

scientific_limitations: The asymptotics are specific to the displayed interleaved stable Lévy partition, not a classification of all two-type branching mechanisms.
The proof concerns explosion-time survival, not extinction at zero or sample-path blow-up rates.
Literature searches and inspected papers do not rule out an unindexed equivalent argument.
title: Two survival-tail scales for an interleaved-stable two-type branching process
